nav.noAuthor: This machine has no current person yet

metrics.cursorPoolsTooltip: Share of Cursor Models and Other Models this cycle. Seat price is unknown, so there is no dollar share.
metrics.cursorBudgetTooltip: Share of the Cursor seat for the current billing cycle. Breakdown is on Stats.
metrics.cursorSpendTooltip: Extra billed after included pools for the current billing cycle. Breakdown is on Stats.

spend.title: Cursor spend
spend.personalHoursTodayInCycle: Today by hour; full period — switch to By day
spend.periodBoundaryHint: Amber ring marks billing period start and end
spend.billingPeriodMarkersHint: Amber ring — subscription billing period start day
spend.consumptionHover: Hover a column — details stay while the pointer is in this card

usage.sharedHint: Part of the shared meter — do not add these amounts.
usage.sharedTask: Another task was active in the same windows — dollars stay unsplit
usage.sharedResearch: Research or another task was active in the same windows

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: In progress is live snapshot slots. A start with no complete that Pulse no longer shows is treated as closed.
tasks.evolutionHint: A fix lists related tasks; those edges make the tree. Reopening the same feature keeps one card.

pulse.title: Team Pulse
pulse.noActiveTask: No active task. Workspace is ready for assignment.
pulse.researchNoBranch: Research is not tied to a branch — it can run next to a task.
pulse.straySubtitle: feat/fix branches that nobody currently has as an in-progress or parked task.

project.emptyBoard: No services yet — start a task in Cursor, or add people later.

github.title: GitHub organization
github.unbound: No organization is bound in project_profile.json yet.
github.authMissing: gh is not installed on this machine

create.title: Add a project unit
create.subtitle: Creates a private GitHub repository in {{org}} and a local folder next to Common.
create.needOrg: Bind a GitHub organization before adding units.
create.needAuth: Sign in with gh auth login; status updates automatically.
create.name: Name
create.ok: Unit created, profile pushed to Common. {{url}}
create.okLocal: Unit created, but Common was not pushed: {{warning}} {{url}}

relay.title: External signals
relay.subtitle: Events from your task tracker, repo, and CI flow through the team relay. Secrets stay on that service; this computer only keeps access.
relay.pairHelp: HTTPS for a remote relay. Local dev — http://127.0.0.1 and the relay port. Pairing (URL + token) is stored on this machine only, not in git.
relay.localHint: Run relay locally; copy the bearer token from RELAY_BEARER_TOKEN or Common/data/.relay_bearer_token (created on first start).
relay.connectError: Could not connect. Check the URL and that relay is running.
relay.connectTimeout: Relay health check timed out (20s). Wrong URL, relay down, or network issue.
relay.sourcesLoading: No sources yet, or relay did not respond.
relay.inboxReview: Notes tied to your branches and tasks: reviews, comments, tracker status changes
relay.inboxCi: Build and check results for the same branches
relay.inboxLater: If the computer is off, the note waits and appears the next time you open Coordinator
relay.inboxHidden: Without a connection these signals stay hidden.
relay.adaptersHelp: Turned on by a relay admin. The list below is fetched from the connected relay; this page is read-only.
relay.adaptersEmpty: Connect to the relay to see which sources your team enabled (each team picks its own).
relay.tokensHelp: Admins issue bearer tokens for relay API access. Each person uses their token when connecting. Secrets are shown once.
relay.tokensCopyOnce: Copy this token now — it will not be shown again.

events.title: Event log
events.previewHelp: Facts delivered from the team relay (git bus). Click a row for full properties.
events.allHelp: Newest first. Filter by connector; paginate through the full log.
events.empty: No events yet. They appear after connectors publish to the state bus.

activity.title: Connector activity log
activity.previewHelp: Poll checks and operational notes on relay. Not published to the Coordinator state bus.
activity.allHelp: Newest first. Filter by connector and paginate.
activity.empty: No entries yet — they appear after poll checks or connector errors.
activity.pollCheckOk: Check ({{trigger}}): {{checked}} models, all without a sunset date.
activity.pollCheckAllNoExpiration: Check ({{trigger}}): {{checked}} models — none have an expiration date set.
activity.pollCheckWithFindings: Check ({{trigger}}): {{checked}} models; {{published}} event(s) to the bus (removed: {{removed}}, expired: {{expired}}, deprecating: {{deprecating}}).

settings.title: Relay settings
settings.subtitle: Pairing with the team relay and issued API tokens. Connector secrets are configured on the marketplace page.

marketplace.title: Connector marketplace
marketplace.help: Built-in connectors on this relay. Turn them on here; secrets stay encrypted on the relay host. Status badges show whether a connector is active.
marketplace.needConnection: Connect to the relay in settings to browse and enable connectors.
marketplace.empty: No connectors on this relay yet.
marketplace.adminOnly: Only relay admins can change secrets and enable connectors. Use the master bearer token when pairing.
marketplace.disableConfirmBody: {{name}} will stop polling and publishing events. Encrypted secrets stay on the relay until you clear them manually.
marketplace.configLoadError: Could not load connector settings from relay.
marketplace.secretSavedHint: A value is stored on relay. Leave blank to keep it; type a new value to replace.
marketplace.nonSecretOnRelay: Value loaded from relay (edit and Save to change).
marketplace.timeoutError: Saving connector settings took too long (Coordinator → relay → Postgres). Check relay URL and master token in Relay settings, then retry.
marketplace.pollOk: Check finished. Details are in the connector activity log; important facts go to the event log after the state bus syncs.
marketplace.pollHelp: Runs the same job as the scheduled poll (OpenRouter catalog vs watch list).
marketplace.noActions: No quick actions for this connector yet.

team.title: Team roster
team.subtitle: Who is on the project: name, role, and departments.
team.saveFootnote: Save updates team.json in Common (main branch).
team.aliasHint: Filled from the name unless you type it yourself.
team.name: Name
team.focusHint: Optional: repos this person usually works in — hints for the coordinator.
team.savedLocal: Saved on disk; Common push failed: {{warning}}

org.title: Organization
org.subtitle: Departments and how they relate. Stored in org_topology.json (Common).
org.crewsHelp: A department or group. Name is what you see in the UI; code is the stable id in JSON and the roster (Latin slug).
org.crewCodeHint: Stored in team.json and org_topology. Filled from the name; avoid changing after save.
org.connectorsHelp: Who cares about whose work — e.g. “QA watches Core releases”. Not git or tasks; context for Otto and future Pulse. Optional.
org.connectorsEmpty: No links yet — a department list alone is enough to start.

timeline.title: Activity Log
timeline.subtitle: Chronological history of team events
timeline.empty: No events recorded yet. Start a task to see events appear.

docs.missing: No markdown file for this task in Common/docs.

work.title: Work items
work.subtitle: Backlog and open tasks — separate from Pulse slots.
work.empty: No work items yet. Plan one with task_planned or start from Cursor.

setup.helloLine2: My name is {{name}}, and I'll help you and your team keep tasks coordinated.
setup.docsDirHint: Relative to the project root. Markdown for tasks, for example docs
setup.dataDirHint: Team, statuses, local files. For example coordinator-data
setup.soloLead: One developer. Task states stay on this machine.
setup.soloPointLocal: No git bus for statuses — a fast start.
setup.soloPointChats: Two Cursor chats on one Mac are fine.
setup.soloPointPeople: Not for several people or machines.
setup.teamLead: Several people and machines. States sync through git.
setup.teamPointAgents: Parallel agents on different machines are safe.
setup.teamPointRepo: Needs an existing repo, or a separate one for the bus.
setup.teamPointMono: In a monorepo the bus lives in the same git — no extra repo.
setup.nextBody: Open Cursor and start a task — or add a person on the Team page when you are ready.
